from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u081/system/state/workspace/programs/task-31900ee2.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]\n    bottom = max(r for r, c, v in cells)\n    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]\n    for r, c, v in cells:\n        nc = c - (bottom - r)\n        if 0 <= nc < w:\n            out[r][nc] = v\n    return out\n'''
p.write_text(code)
grid=[[0]*13 for _ in range(11)]
vals={3:[6,7,8],4:[4,5,6,8],5:[4,8],6:[4,5,8],7:[5,8,9],8:[5,9],9:[5,6,7,8,9]}
for r,cs in vals.items():
 for c in cs:grid[r][c]=7
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
out=transform(grid)
print(out)
